name: Europa-Universität Flensburg
englishBachelors: One: European Cultures and Society, taught entirely in English. Its other bachelor's degrees need German.
note: A public university by the Danish border, about 40 km from Sønderborg. Its only English-taught bachelor's is European Cultures and Society; International Management needs German as well as English.
summary: Public university in Flensburg, just south of the Danish border. One bachelor's is taught in English, European Cultures and Society, with open admission and no tuition.

handoff.label: BA European Cultures and Society: applying

ib.text: A full IB Diploma meeting Germany's KMK rules (Course Results are not enough), plus proof of English such as IELTS 6.5. No minimum grade: admission is open.

apply.via: EUF's own portal (EU/EEA citizens apply directly)

notes: The 15 August deadline is published as a yearly date without a year; EUF's own calendar confirms that 2027 applications open on 15 May 2027. All documents must be uploaded by the deadline.
Studies start with an orientation week on 6–10 September 2027.
Ask the admissions office early to check your certificates: if it must refer them to the central office in Bonn, the review can take months and must finish by the deadline.
International Management – BWL is taught partly in German, Danish or Spanish and needs proof of German, so it is not listed here. Its German-Danish track is a double degree with SDU in Sønderborg.

sources.title: European Cultures and Society (EUCS), Bachelor of Arts: six semesters, starts in the fall semester (September), taught in English, no tuition but a semester fee, with a mandatory semester abroad. EU citizens apply from 15 May to 15 August. No minimum grade (NC); an Abitur-equivalent qualification and proof of English are required; no German is needed.
sources.quote: Degree Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) Duration 6 semesters (= 3 years) Study start Fall semester (= September) Languages English Application period Application period for EU citizens: May 15 to August 15 Application period for non-EU citizens: December 1 to August 15 Tuition fees None, but a semester fee is payable each semester [...] The program is open to all applicants – there is no minimum grade requirement (numerus clausus/NC). [...] You do not need any knowledge of German for this degree program.

sources.title: Applying to the BA European Cultures and Society: unrestricted admission; EU applicants apply for the fall semester from 15 May to 15 August in the EUF portal with all documents uploaded by the deadline; no DoSV registration; an Abitur-equivalent entrance qualification and proof of English (for example IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 90) are required, and missing English proof can follow by 28 February.
sources.quote: This degree program has an unrestricted admission. [...] EU applicants: To begin studies in the fall semester (program semesters 1, 3 or 5) May 15 Application period opens August 15 Application period closes [...] A parallel application/registration with the Foundation for University Admissions (DoSV) is not necessary. [...] The documents must be uploaded to the portal no later than the last day of the application period (application deadline). [...] Additionally, adequate proficiency in English is required. [...] If you are unable to provide proof of the required language skills by the application deadline, you may still apply. However, possible admission will then be subject to the condition that you have to provide proof that you meet the language qualification by February 28

sources.title: EUCS application requirements: an entrance qualification equivalent to the German Abitur, and proof of English issued within the past two years (a school-leaving qualification from an English-speaking school, a 180-credit English-taught degree, Cambridge B2 First grade B (175), C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency, IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 90 or Oxford Test of English 135). Native speakers also need one of these.
sources.quote: International applicants (EU and non-EU applicants) need to have a high school certificate which is equivalent to the German high school certificate. [...] b) A school-leaving qualification from an English-speaking school qualifying for university entrance [...] 4. IELTS (International English Language Testing System): Band Score 6,5 5. TOEFL iBT (Test of English as a Foreign Language): Mindestpunktzahl 90 Punkte [...] Only the mentioned certificates and minimum grades mentioned are accepted. Native speakers must also provide one of the certificates mentioned above under a) or b)

sources.title: EUF's calendar file for the 2027 application start: applications open on 15 May 2027.
sources.quote: Application Start EUF 2027 [...] Apply for your studies at Uni Flensburg starting today! [event on 15 May 2027 from 10:00]

sources.title: Enrolling for the fall semester 2026 cost EUR 463.80: EUR 89 to the Studentenwerk, EUR 226.80 for the semester ticket, EUR 3 social fund, EUR 25 student body, EUR 60 administrative fee and EUR 60 registration fee.
sources.quote: for Fall Semester 2026 amount contribution to the Studentenwerk 89,00 € semester ticket 226,80 € social fund contribution 3,00 € contribution to the student body 25,00 € administrative fee 60,00 € registration fee 60,00 € sum 463,80 €

sources.title: Studies begin with a joint orientation week, from 6 to 10 September 2027 in the fall semester 2027/28.
sources.quote: For most degree programs, studies commence with a joint orientation week, which in the fall semester 2027/28 will take place from September 6 to September 10, 2027.

sources.title: Europa-Universität Flensburg is a statutory public body supervised by Schleswig-Holstein's Ministry of General Education and Vocational Training, Science, Research and Culture.
sources.quote: The Europa-Universität Flensburg is a statutory public body. [...] Supervisory authority Ministry of General Education and Vocational Training, Science, Research and Culture

sources.title: EUF's bachelor programmes and their teaching languages: European Cultures and Society (English); International Management – BWL (German, English, Danish, Spanish); Social Sciences: Social and Political Change (German, English); Transcultural European Studies (German, French, Spanish); Educational Sciences.
BA International Management – BWL is taught in German, English, Danish and Spanish; applicants must prove German and English and have basic Danish or Spanish.
sources.quote: Languages German, English, Danish, Spanish [...] You need to speak and be able to prove your skills in German and English, plus have basic knowledge of either Danish or Spanish, depending on your track.

sources.title: KMK agreement on recognising the IB Diploma (version of 15 June 2023; school list of 26 March 2026): the full Diploma, with the required subject spread, gives German higher-education entrance; Course Results are not covered.

programmes.name: European Cultures and Society
programmes.about: How Europe's cultures and societies interact, across culture, politics, media, society and economics, taught in English. After two introductory semesters you focus on European cultures or European society, and a semester abroad in the fourth or fifth semester is compulsory.
programmes.selectionNote: Unrestricted admission: everyone who meets the requirements by 15 August is admitted.

structure.teachingStyle: Interactive seminars and practical projects, for example in journalism, storytelling with space, research or creative business. You earn 30 credits each semester.
structure.studyAbroad: A semester abroad in the fourth or fifth semester is compulsory, at one of almost 90 partner universities or another of your choice, usually with Erasmus funding.

requirements.label: A full IB Diploma that meets Germany's KMK recognition rules (Abitur-equivalent)

requirements.label: Proof of English, such as IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 90 or Cambridge B2 First grade B, or an English-speaking school

officialWording.text: a) A school-leaving qualification from an English-speaking school qualifying for university entrance b) Completion of an undergraduate degree program of at least 180 CP in which the language of instruction and examination is English, c) The following minimum score or grade in a recognized language test

requirements.note: EUF does not name the IB on its list. Ask admissions.eucs@uni-flensburg.de whether an English-taught IB Diploma counts as a qualification from an English-speaking school. Proof can follow by 28 February 2028, as a condition of admission.
requirements.openQuestion: EUF does not say whether an English-taught IB Diploma counts as a qualification from an English-speaking school; ask the admissions office.
